title: 'When I attack, choose an enemy unit here' target prompt offers every unit on the board, including friendly units, units in base, and Riven herself
expected: Parser reproduces the report: parseAbilities on Riven, Shattered's text yields the triggered ability's damage effect with target {type:"unit"} only (ran the parser via bun). Root cause: packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/triggers.ts:68-71 strips the "Choose (a|an) (friendly|enemy)? unit (here|there|at a battlefield)." preamble from triggered-ability effect text and discards it (replace with ""), unlike spells.ts:180-194/216 which captures the preamble via CHOOSE_PREAMBLE_RE and bindChosenTarget()s it onto the "it" reference. The remaining "Deal 2 to it for each Equipment attached to me" hits effects-damage.ts:78-91 where parseCardTarget("it") produces an unrestricted {type:"unit"}, so the enemy/here restriction is lost and the engine offers every unit on board (friendly, in base, self).
observed: pendingChoice choose-target options = [player-1 Mystic Poro (friendly, in base), player-2 Mega-Mech, player-2 Playful Phantom, player-1 Riven, Shattered (self)]; UI 'Choose a target' modal showed all four. Server /api/cards/ven-041-166 shows the parsed triggered ability target is just {type:'unit'} with no controller:'enemy' / location:'here' restriction
